author: Mark Atwood
text: DECISION 2026-05-12 (Mark, interactive): B) Add AiaFetcher trait. pkix-chain / pkix-path-builder gain a new pluggable callback for online intermediate retrieval per RFC 5280 §4.2.2.1, with NoAiaFetcher zero-cost default matching the SignatureVerifier + RevocationChecker pattern. NOTE: this overrides the recommended A (no AIA-fetch) from this session's analysis. Pro-B rationale (architectural-consistency case): (1) Trait + zero-cost default is the established workspace pattern -- SignatureVerifier for crypto, RevocationChecker for §6.3, AiaFetcher for AIA. Three callbacks form the complete mozilla::pkix-style trust-domain seam. (2) no_std story improves: callers in no_std contexts cannot easily 'fetch HTTP yourself and add to bundle'; the trait gives a clean injection point regardless of std/no_std. (3) AIA parsing already shipped in pkix-revocation-http::extract_aia_http_urls -- the ca_issuers half of AiaUrls is currently dead surface; this work activates it. (4) Path of regret reframed: vestigial trait surface (cost if B is wrong) is judged smaller than 'caller cannot inject AIA without re-rolling verify_chain' (cost if A is wrong in no_std contexts). DOWNSTREAM SHAPE DECISIONS not resolved by this bead, deferred to implementation children: trait location (pkix-path-builder vs pkix-chain re-export); sync vs async (or both, matching pkix-revocation-http's RevocationChecker / AsyncRevocationChecker pair); error type (new AiaError enum vs piggyback on path-builder Error); failure-mode contract (return error vs fall through to bundle-only); caching contract (trait-side vs caller-side); HTTP impl crate location (expand pkix-revocation-http vs new pkix-aia-http vs pkix-chain feature-flag). FOLLOW-UP: decompose into implementation children in a separate planning step. Reference: pkix-revocation-http/src/extract.rs:139 already provides extract_aia_http_urls(); pkix-revocation-http/src/cache.rs:743 shows the established pattern of consuming AiaUrls.ocsp; the same pattern applies for AiaUrls.ca_issuers.
